title: Require wiki on task cards and generate per-feature changelogs

sections.what: Make `wiki:` required on new task cards, and generate a `## Changelog` on each feature page from the tasks whose `wiki:` points at it - so every feature carries a real, dated history of what changed and why.
sections.why: The task <-> feature edge already exists (`doc_connected.py` reads task `wiki:` frontmatter) but it is optional, so the join is patchy. The goal is a wiki where each dev task is tied to its feature and the page shows the history.
sections.how: Have `tasks.py validate` warn (then error) on a missing `wiki:`. Add a generator that reads the task tree, groups by `wiki:` target, and writes each page's `## Changelog` between markers (like `doc_connected`). Wire it into the vault guards when stable.
sections.verify:
1. File a task with no `wiki:`.
   - expected: `tasks.py validate` warns.
   - observed: TODO
2. Run the changelog generator, open `Movement.md`.
   - expected: a dated changelog of the tasks that touched movement.
   - observed: TODO

acceptance.text: new task cards are required to carry `wiki:`
feature pages show a generated, dated changelog
the changelog is built from the task tree, never hand-maintained
